doc.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

title: Names autographed on Tom Brown's 1955 script
summary: The interviewer reads the 38 friends' names who autographed Tom's 1955 script, with Mrs. Brown helping on spellings.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Now, we have here a little write up that says this script was composed and written June the 3rd, 1955. Let's see, and copyrighted it looks like there too. By Tom Brown, an autographed by good friends. 38 names more on the back, including Tom Brown first, and then Sherwood Manjapan, Edmond Sushan, M.D., Pete Mellom, Mara Menville, Frank Bonin, singer Johnny Wiggs, Bill Lambert, Alfred Lobre, Vincent Varisco. Somebody Brown whose name I can't read. Yes.
Is that FN? Looks like the FN. Oh, uh, Varisco, Vincent. Oh, Vincent Varisco. He played the tom.
Lloyd T. Bacon, Ted Brown, Charles W.R.O.C.H. it looks like, Rock, Roach. Roach. Roach.
Mrs. Catherine Burke. Burke. Raymond Burke. Raymond Burke. Oh, that's Raymond's wife. Yes. Dominic. Dominic. Dominic.
Edward Chance. Edward J. I guess that is. Mm-hmm. Joe L.A-I-M-O. Peter. P-A-L-M-A Palamo. Ronald J. Loicano. And Mrs. Lillian.
